cohort: 1,034,552 births in Ohio from 2006 to 2012, with analysis limited to 251,398 singleton live births in term (37 to 42 weeks) primiparas
finding: While excessive GWG increased the risk of PCD in both adolescents and adults, younger maternal age was found to be protective against PCD, even in the presence of excessive GWG.
mod_finding: The primary cesarean rate was lower for adolescents compared with adults.
